description: Connection status, network-change notifications and the server clock.

enums.name: NetworkInterfaceKind
enums.description: Standardized platform network interface kind, part of the local network fingerprint.

enums.name: ConnectionPhase
enums.description: Where the link supervisor is: the one connection state hosts and the Kit ConnectionNotice read.

enums.name: ConnectionQuality
enums.description: Line quality while online. Neither value shows a banner; poor shows on the diagnostics page.

models.name: NetworkChangeRequest
models.description: Platform network-change notification. The link supervisor alone decides whether and how to reconnect.

fields.name: available
fields.description: Whether a network route is currently available. Omitted means available.

fields.name: expensive
fields.description: Whether the active route is considered expensive by the platform.

fields.name: metered
fields.description: Whether the active route is metered.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Optional platform reason string for diagnostics.

fields.name: fingerprintHint
fields.description: Coarse network identity (native: a 16-hex-digit SHA-256 digest of the interface kind and the default gateway, plus the DNS servers on Android, or the cellular MCC-MNC; web: navigator.connection.type). Hashed locally with interface into the network fingerprint that keys access point health; never sent anywhere. Never pass an SSID or a raw address.

models.name: ConnectionStatus
models.description: Payload of connection://status and the value of connection.getStatus. Every field is present (null without a value): hosts replace their copy whole on every event and hand it to the Kit ConnectionNotice unchanged.

fields.name: quality
fields.description: Line quality; set only while online.

fields.name: cellId
fields.description: Cell of the current access point.

fields.name: regionId
fields.description: Region of the current access point.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Transport of the current connection: quic or ws.

fields.name: rttMs
fields.description: Latest heartbeat round trip (the handshake time before the first sample).

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: Which round of the current recovery this is; zero once online.

fields.name: nextRetryAt
fields.description: When the next round starts: Unix milliseconds on the device clock (not the server clock, not a delay).

fields.name: reason
fields.description: actionRequired: kicked, expired, upgradeRequired or tenantUnavailable. switching: failure, drain, failback, manual or manifest.

fields.name: developmentMode
fields.description: Endpoints come from development-mode configuration: the Kit shows its development badge in every phase.

models.name: ServerClockResponse
models.description: The core's estimate of how far the server clock is from this device's.

fields.name: offsetMs
fields.description: Server clock minus device clock, in milliseconds; 0 until estimated.

fields.name: estimated
fields.description: Whether the offset rests on a server frame received this session.
